characters.name: Angry Grandpa
characters.description: Affably Evil: When he isn't screaming and breaking everything in sight, Angry Grandpa comes across as a very nice guy and is more then willing to takes a few photos with fans. Angrish: He speaks this as his second language. Anti-Hero: A mix between this and a villain. Asshole Victim: Of Michael's pranks. Ax-Crazy: Bonus points for actually owning an ax.

characters.name: Michael Green
characters.description: Appropriated Appellation: Michael's alias "Pickleboy" was given to him by Angry Grandpa following a prank that backfired on him, in which Angry Grandpa poured pickle juice on him. Berserk Button: Has a few, includingtexting him when he's singing along with music on his phoneand interrupting his intro routine. Blind Without 'Em: Downplayed. Pickleboy can't see faces without his glasses. Catchphrase:"What's going on you guys?KidBehindACamerahere,...""Calm down!""You need to chill!""Come on with all this!" "What's going on you guys?KidBehindACamerahere,..."

characters.name: Bridgette West
characters.description: Bad Liar:Zig-Zagged. Bridgette is reasonably competent at telling lies in situations in which the lie is rehearsed (for pranks and such), but she struggles at times to come up with a reasonable lie on the spot or when flustered. The latter situation prompts her to ask Angry Grandpa to lie for her inPICKLEBOY'S BROKEN GLASSES!. On the other hand, her usual awkwardness seems to play in her favor in this case. Catchphrase:[After Michael introduces himself] "Bridgette Westheeere!"[After Michael tells the audience to like and subscribe to his channel] "Follow me on everything!"[When Michael is caught doing something embarrassing] "You're so cute!"[When Michael tells her to shut the camera off during a prank]"I'm filming for legal reasons!" [After Michael introduces himself] "Bridgette Westheeere!" [After Michael tells the audience to like and subscribe to his channel] "Follow me on everything!" [When Michael is caught doing something embarrassing] "You're so cute!"

characters.name: Tina Green
characters.description: Bad Liar: Tina struggles to come up with these, such as when she had "No idea" what she spent 350 dollars on instead of paying the utility bill in the "Lights Out" series.Grandpa:Are you happy? What'd you buy, anyway, what'd you buy?!Tina:I dunno...Grandpa:WHAT'D YOU BUY?!Tina:I have no idea!Grandpa:How do you spend that kind of money and not even know what you bought?!Jimmy:I doooo!Grandpa:He do!Michael:She bought someElvis stuff, I know...Grandpa:Oh god,I'll tear that motherfuckin' shit up... Crazy Cat Lady: A variant. When living in the Trailwood trailer park, Tina would feed a large family of cats living underneath the trailer, which Angry Grandpa would hear at night under the floor. She apparently had a habit of feeding leftover turkey to said cats, fueling a few of his outbursts. Loony Fan: She is downrightobsessed withElvis Presley, toGrandpa's chagrin.She's obsessed to the point where she regularly spends money for bills on Graceland. Put on a Bus: Once her marriage to Angry Grandpa ended.Commuting on a Bus: Shehasshown up in a few videos, but following her divorce with Grandpa, her appearances have become very rare. Commuting on a Bus: Shehasshown up in a few videos, but following her divorce with Grandpa, her appearances have become very rare.

characters.name: Jennifer Green
characters.description: Michael's older sister. She would often appear in vlogs and often hang out in Grandpa's trailer, where he would often yell at her to get a job. Ambiguously Bi: She was in several relationships with men, including a man named Chris Price and even Doug, but was speculated by Michael and Bridgette to be more than just friends with Tina Dandridge in "TINA AND JENNIFER ARE DATING!" Older Than They Look: She's in her 40s but suffers from advanced aging, and also has premature gray hair because of an abnormal gene she shares with Michael.

characters.name: Tina Dandridge
characters.description: Angry Grandpa's (former) neighbor. She's appeared as an archnemesis of sorts for Angry Grandpa after a volatile Fourth of July confrontation. Just as loud and abrasive as Angry Grandpa, she is consideredThe Rivalfor putting him in his place and getting the biggest rise out of him so far. Abhorrent Admirer: Sometimes she pretends to be this to disgust and piss off Angry Grandpa. Most notably inGRANDPA SEDUCES TINA, she flips the script on his advances and immediately demands that she have his babies, prompting him to lock himself in his car in fear. Cranky Neighbor: Her initial appearances had her confronting Grandpa about territorial disputes. Enemy Mine: She has joined forces with Pickleboy in pranking Angry Grandpa in a few videos. Go-Karting with Bowser: One video had her visiting and kicking back on the porch with Angry Grandpa without so much as a blowout.Michael's blogs have also revealed that they hang out together when Tina's son plays with one of Grandpa's grandkids.

characters.name: Doug West
characters.description: Bridgette's father. He made his debut in "PICKLEBOY'S REAL DAD!" and became a regular member of the cast between 2015 and 2017. Unfortunately, he would go on to slander his daughter, (the late) Angry Grandpa, and Michael, which led to several confrontations between them prior to his death in early 2024. Big Bad: Of the "Confrontation with Doug" arc. Embarrassing Nickname: Michael jokingly called him "Dung" from time to time,and started to frequently refer to him as "Dung" when he started spreading rumors about him.

characters.name: Derrick Mims
characters.description: The owner of the now-retired Substation II and a close friend of Angry Grandpa and the Green Family. Hidden Depths: Aside from being a talented sandwich maker, he also has an interest in the Pittsburgh Steelers and fishing, according to "SUB STATION IS GONE".

characters.name: iMustDestroyAll
characters.description: AYouTuberthat claims to be a demon from Hell who threatened to destroy Grandpa. Michael involves him in a prank on Grandpa where he tricks him into believing thatMustDestroyAllhas been breaking into his trailer and stalking him. Along withTina DandridgeandThe Hag, he's been considered anArch-Enemyof Angry Grandpa, at least until he found out it was all just a prank. Big Bad: Of theiMustDestroyAllprank series. Catchphrase: "Angry Grandpa...You're mine!" Enemy Eats Your Lunch: He constantly taunts Angry Grandpa by telling him thathe ate some of his candy after breaking into his house and stalking him.This pisses Angry Grandpa off to no end. Evil Is Hammy: "Well, now I'm back, and I'm taking over your audio devices with...DESTRUCTION!"

characters.name: The Obsessed Fan
characters.description: A friend of Michael's who participated in one of his pranks on Angry Grandpa, pretending to be anAx-CrazyLoony Fanstalking the latter to play into his fear of people looking at him through the windows at night. Cop Killer: Implied, as Michael and Grandpa hear a police siren after they tell him to leave, thinking he would be apprehended by them, only to return later holding a bloody knife. Mean Character, Nice Actor: He pretends to be a psychotic stalker obsessed with Angry Grandpa, but in reality is just a normal guy in cahoots with Michael. Psycho Knife Nut: During the climax of the prank, he breaks into Angry Grandpa's trailer wielding a blood-soaked knife as he advances upon him.

characters.name: FatBoyGetDown
characters.description: A morbidly obeseYouTuberand cast member ofMy 600-lb Lifewho would often show up on The Angry Grandpa Show to mess with Angry Grandpa, even helping Michael convince Grandpa that he drank his spit for a prank. Fat Bastard: He weighed over 800 pounds at the time of his appearances and was an absoluteJerkass. Go-Karting with Bowser: He was also incredibly rude and provocative towards Michael, but eventually teamed up with him for the "spit in a jar" prank on Grandpa. Sitcom Arch-Nemesis: With Angry Grandpa to almost Neighbor Tina-like levels of animosity. Troll: He would frequently screw around with Grandpa just to get a rise out of him.

characters.name: The Gaboon Viper
characters.description: A deadly snake from sub-Saharan Africa that somehow made its way to South Carolina, much to the terror of Angry Grandpa. While the Gaboon Viper is never properly seen throughout the series, Grandpa spent time both hunting it for a reward and hiding from it, as it can easily kill its prey with one bite. It was also the subject ofATTACK OF THE GABOON VIPER - THE SNAKE BITE PRANK!, where Michael tricks Grandpa into believing that it bit him. Animal Assassin: Its a stealthy predator that Grandpa tries to keep an eye out for. Deadly Lunge: To quote Grandpa, "The motherfucker goesthhk!And yer dead!" The Ghost: It never actually appears in the series proper, aside from a fake rubber snake Michael uses in a prank. Names To Run Away From Very Fast: Michael constantly refers to it as"The Kaboom Viper"because "that's the sound you'll make when you hit the ground after it bites you!"
